name: Sweepstakes / celebrity giveaway campaign ad

shots.visual: Celebrity says the prize to camera

shots.audio_text: Social proof for the next round

prompts.prompt: Official rules, no-purchase-necessary entry, eligibility, odds, sponsor address, end date; use an administrator (e.g. Marden-Kane) for US sweepstakes.

references.author: Seanfrank
references.note: Ridge's "2026 Summer Sweepstakes" key visual: two men next to a lifted truck under the headline "Prizes worthy of a pro", with Shop Now and Learn More buttons. A celebrity-backed giveaway is the creative.

references.author: gleamapp
references.note: NEW from Gleam. Spending money on ads and wondering if a giveaway could get you leads for less? Use the Giveaway vs Paid Ads Cost Per Lead Calculator.

references.author: EcomVictor
references.note: If you're not offer-stacking and valuemaxxing in 2026 as an ecom brand, scaling profitably will be MUCH harder for you. Grüns is pushing a discount +

qa_checklist: Hook lands in the first 1.5 s (video) or is readable at thumbnail size (static / slide 1).
Removal test: delete the product from the script. If it still makes sense, rewrite so the product is the payoff.
Matches the reference structure (same beat order and length band) before any creative twist.
Uses only real product imagery for the product; AI is for backgrounds, characters or b-roll, and is disclosed where required.
Every claim is on the brand's approved-claims list (PDP); no invented stats, reviews, doctors or customers.
Captions burned in and inside the safe zone; sound-off still understandable.
One clear CTA that matches the landing page offer.
Three hook variants delivered for the same body (test hooks, not whole new ads).
Avoid: Sweepstakes law: purchase cannot be required to enter in the US; get official rules reviewed.
Avoid: Collect consent for email/SMS properly (TCPA).
Avoid: Celebrity likeness needs a contract.
inputs: BRAND (name, product, price, offer, audience, proof points, banned claims)
ASSETS (real product photos/video, logo, fonts, colors)
outputs: brands/<brand-slug>.md with 3 concepts in the output schema below
per concept: script/slide copy, shot list, on-screen text, caption, CTA, 3 hook variants, prompts used
